fusions.name: Bread Snatch
fusions.desc: Snatches a bite out of a target that deals 4 damage, healing you for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Gorging Frenzy
fusions.desc: Feeds on everything around you at once, dealing 26 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit, and you restore 15 health.

fusions.name: Crumbs for All
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles. The amount rises 1% for each 1% of cast speed.

fusions.name: Fuel for the Flyway
fusions.desc: When you regain health, you also regain 3 stamina a second for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
